name: TPR Co., Ltd.
summary: TPR Co., Ltd. engages in the development and sale of engine components in Japan, Asia, North America, and internationally. The company offers powertrain parts, such as piston rings, cylinder liners, carbon scraper rings, valve seat, valve guide, sintered/steel seal ring, and shock absorber parts. It also provides industrial rubber parts, resin seal rings, home equipment, temperature control valves, infrared heater/related equipment, aluminum products; EV related products, such as driver and battery related products, as well as surface treatment products.
